proof_scope: Real Host runs actual FS/GitFS/Sessions and proves distinct direct/overlay records, visible divergence, operation tags, exact pinned commit/blob references and restart.
Real standalone Host omits Sessions and its grant; GitFS mutation remains usable with unavailable attribution.
Negative SDK fixture supplies only failure responses, proves initialization error within2seconds and partial/unknown recording without mutation replay.
Actual bulk materialization applies65 paths despite64-record cap, retains64 records+1omitted, and preserves those effects across a later failed path.
Existing tool consumers, policy enforcement, reviewed local commit and exact recorded-push/no-replay fixtures passed.
resolved_failures: Initial discovery-failure fixture waited for process exit although SDK emits an explicit initialization-error frame and awaits host shutdown. Fixed fixture to assert that actual error frame within deadline; final3/98 passed.
Initial unit helper attempted to access private Git command function; uses ordinary Git commands against disposable fixture instead, preserving production visibility.
limitations: Attribution is provider-reported, never authentication or ownership.
Capture and Sessions append are separate; failed or lost responses can leave recording unknown.
64 records/256KiB retained per operation; unsafe preimages or uncertain writes counted explicitly.
Existing external-writer/materialization races and partial cancellation remain; no rollback, retry or delivery journal.
Older Sessions writers must not mutate upgraded snapshots; current runtime binary identity is pinned without claiming unrelated dirty runtime sources rebuilt.
coordinator_actions: Collect source and refresh earlier GitFS source-overlapping receipts; source held stable.
Retain exact already-resolved GitFS-to-Sessions/libc shared Cargo.lock edges under runtime grants leaf.
Runtime grant leaf must run native fixture with PROVENANCE_EXPECT_SHIPPED_GRANTS=1; it asserts all3 shipped GitFS entries have exact Sessions grant.
Bind parent rollup executable prerequisite receipts and current owner footprint unions once all children refreshed.
